# ImportAlpha Lite

> China-to-US product sourcing intelligence, sold as an API to autonomous
> agents. Ask whether a physical product is worth importing and get a
> structured answer: opportunity score, China unit-cost range, landed cost,
> margin, competition signal and risk flags — with source_url, observed_at and
> confidence attached to every datapoint.

Two ways to pay, both without a signup form. An API key draws on a prepaid
balance bought with a card. An x402 on-chain USDC transfer needs no account at
all: pay, then send the transaction hash in an `X-Payment-Hash` header.

Live payment parameters — wallet address, price, network — are served at
`/v1/agent/info`. **Read them from there, not from this file.** A wallet
address checked into a static manifest goes stale silently, and the cost of
that mistake is an agent's funds sent somewhere we do not control. The same
values also come back in the body of any `402 Payment Required` response.

Data honesty: every response carries a `status` field. `curated` means the
numbers were hand-written for development and never observed anywhere. Do not
resell, quote or make purchasing decisions on `curated` data. Only `ok` means
observed. At the time of writing this service returns `curated`.

## Discovery

- [/v1/agent/info](/v1/agent/info): live payment parameters, auth methods,
  accepted networks and the endpoint list, as JSON. The authoritative source.
- [/agent-guide](/agent-guide): long-form guide in markdown — paying with
  x402, getting testnet USDC, worked curl examples.
- [/openapi.json](/openapi.json): the full OpenAPI 3.1 contract, generated
  from the code, so it cannot drift from what the server actually does.
- [/health](/health): version, uptime and dependency state.

## Endpoints

- [GET /v1/opportunities](/v1/opportunities): scored product opportunities for
  a category. Requires auth.
- [POST /v1/landed-cost](/v1/landed-cost): landed cost for a given unit cost,
  unit weight and quantity. Requires auth.
- [POST /v1/reports](/v1/reports): request a product viability report. Costs
  one credit. Returns 202 and a `report_id`.
- [GET /v1/reports/{report_id}](/v1/reports/): poll a requested report.
- [GET /v1/public/sample-reports](/v1/public/sample-reports): three synthetic
  specimen reports, no auth. Use these to learn the response shape before
  spending anything.
- [GET /v1/public/pricing](/v1/public/pricing): card pricing tiers, no auth.

## Authentication

- API key: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Issued manually by the operator.
- x402: `X-Payment-Hash: <tx hash>` of a USDC transfer to the wallet named in
  `/v1/agent/info`. One verified transfer grants one credit. An `Authorization`
  header always takes precedence, so sending both ignores the payment rather
  than spending it twice.

## Pricing

- One credit buys one report.
- x402: one credit costs 10,000 USDC base units (USDC has 6 decimals, so
  $0.01) on the accepted network. Confirm the current figure at
  `/v1/agent/info` before paying — it is configurable per deployment.
- Card: $99 for 10 credits, $299 for 100. A $999 custom category feed is
  arranged by contacting the operator, not through the API.

## Networks

- `base-sepolia` — accepted. Testnet USDC at
  `0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2315fA19Ef0`.
- `base-mainnet` — **known but not accepted.** This deployment is testnet only
  and a mainnet payment will be refused. Funds sent there are not recoverable
  by us. Check `accepted` in `/v1/agent/info` rather than assuming.

## Examples

- [Worked curl examples](/agent-guide): both auth methods, the 402 challenge
  and retry loop, and where to get testnet USDC.
